features.name: Local audio playback and caption profile
invariants: Audio player uses Radio profile; keep original media untouched
File processing may be opt-in and may play while generating captions
Never conflate live TV/radio clock with local file timing
features.portability: Reimplement player/view separately from audio decoder; preserve settings and SRT timebase

features.name: Local video playback and caption profile
invariants: Video player uses TV file subtitle settings, not DVB timeshift/Teletext clock
Complete transcribe-first is optional; do not auto-stop playback when disabled
Fullscreen must not leave unwanted bars
features.portability: Port playback through platform adapter; independent subtitle layer

features.name: Live DVB-T2 TV
invariants: Never acquire a second DVB tuner behind user's back
Preserve DVB source/Teletext priority/fallback rules
No complete-before-play mode for live TV
Keep playback distinct from transcription and translation failures
features.portability: Tuner adapter is replaceable behind an explicit ownership lease; backend and UI can change

features.name: Live DAB/radio and Whisper
invariants: On-demand SDR, ownership and Stop/Release must remain explicit
Lyrics/DLS are not spoken transcription
Karaoke sync must not block independent spoken subtitles
Do not reuse TV buffering semantics blindly
features.portability: Preserve device lease, streaming, cue and karaoke boundaries while replacing UI/engine

features.name: Recording and timed export
invariants: Media-only, text-only, and media+subtitle choices remain independent
Never overwrite user recordings
SRT timings must be based on actual evidence, not invented word anchors
Audio-only cannot have burned-in video captions
Live broadcast has no Complete mode
features.portability: Portable export adapter using independently licensed media encoders (e.g. FFmpeg); maintain file types and provenance

features.name: Speech recognition, translation, sound labels and speaker labels
invariants: Original speech survives unavailable translation models
Sound tags do not suppress dialogue
Manual offsets apply to timeline, never repeatedly after every phrase
No AI model is fetched or inferred without explicit consent
features.portability: Separate model backend port from subtitle presentation and preserve failover/errors

portable_repository_links.link_note: App-level PR classification is heuristic, not proof of an individual feature; verify exact diff/commit before attribution.
